title: Standby priming and dependency sanity checks for regional cutover
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Implement an automated readiness and sanity check workflow to ensure warm standbys across regions can accept traffic with minimal cold-start latency and without violating customer SLAs. This ticket covers orchestration logic, gating criteria, and a set of dependency validations (network, model artifact availability, KV cache pre-warm, and routing policy coherence) that must run before automated or manual failover is allowed.

Context and motivation:
- We continue to observe variable tail latencies in cross-region cutovers when standby pools are not fully primed.
- Past incidents showed model variant mismatches and missing quantized artifacts in standby clusters during emergency reroutes.
- Need deterministic gating to reduce blast radius during failover and to make warm-standby guarantees measurable and auditable.

Scope and non-goals:
- Include orchestration and probes for model artifact readiness, kernel compatibility check, KV cache priming directives, and route-policy sanity.
- Integrate with regional routing controller to pause cutover until checks pass or a controlled fallback policy is executed.
- Out of scope: long-term autoscaling policy redesign and pricing changes for standby capacity (separate epics).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Automated readiness runbook executes and publishes a pass/fail score to the console for a target standby pool.
2) If readiness score >= configured threshold, routing controller permits cutover; otherwise it triggers defined fallback (model-variant degrade path or route to next-priority region) and creates an incident ticket.
3) Readiness checks include: model artifact presence (+correct checksum), runtime kernel compatibility, network egress to model storage endpoint, KV pre-warm success (X% of canonical prefixes cached), and health of dependent services (auth, metrics ingestion).
4) Readiness runbook logs are linked to the change-event and retained per compliance retention policy.
5) Smoke generation shows median token-latency on warm standby within 1.2x of primary baseline for a standard prompt set.
tasks: Design probe harness and scoring model for readiness checks
Implement model artifact validator (checksum + manifest) in standby bootstrap
Add kernel/quantization compatibility probe to deployment validator
Expose KV priming API and implement pre-warm job with sample prefix set
Add gating hook to the regional routing controller to consult readiness API
Create fallback orchestration: model-variant degrade chain and route-to-next-tier policy
Add telemetry: readiness_score, probe_durations, primed_prefixes_pct, and failover_reasons
End-to-end test: simulated region outage + automatic cutover with both pass and fail scenarios
Documentation: ops runbook, console dashboard tile, and postmortem checklist
